tldr: The government approved the IPE 2027 timetable: first-year papers start February 24, second-year from February 26, ending March 20.

beats.what: There will be a two-day gap between language papers, four days before Mathematics and five days before Chemistry; TG BIE will release the detailed schedule shortly.
beats.why: Ramzan and Shivratri fall in the exam window; last year SSC exams were similarly stretched to over a month along CBSE lines.
beats.care: Junior lecturers quoted by Telangana Today say long breaks could make some students lose focus; the longer schedule may push results later.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: First-year Inter exams begin February 24, second-year papers from February 26.

cards.q: Longer gaps between Inter papers mean…

qs: Will the longer schedule delay Inter results and college admissions?
How will rural students who take up work during gaps be supported?

facts.t: Last year Telangana stretched SSC exams to *more than a month*, from 10 days earlier.

viz.verdict: Nearly a month of exams for Inter students

learn.t: IPE = Intermediate Public Examinations, Telangana's Class 11–12 board exams.

watch: TG BIE's detailed subject-wise timetable, due shortly.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: Telangana Inter exams stretched to nearly a month, to be held from Feb 24

fact: Telangana Inter exams will now stretch nearly a month: *Feb 24–Mar 20*
twist: They usually wrap up in *a little over two weeks*; Ramzan and Shivratri forced wider gaps.
